READING KEY AND DISCLOSURE BOUNDARY
G3-G6 | Reported structure and evidence limits
|
|-- [R] Seed: one reportable segment
|   `-- [R] FY25 note: allocate resources using consolidated net income.
|-- [I] Payments product costs / operating profit are not isolated here.
|-- [I] No Payments-versus-non-Payments attach comparison is supplied.
|-- [I] No controlled causal test is supplied.
|
|-- Seed-only precision: retained centrally or withheld from expansion
|   |-- [I] FY21-25 net-take bridge cannot be independently recomputed.
|   |-- [I] FY25 "79% GMV / 21% penetration" attribution lacks inputs.
|   |-- [I] Historical yield and "83% explained" attribution lack inputs.
|   `-- [I] Seed Q3 2026 ">68%" lacks a matching excerpt; use Q2 68%.
|
|-- [I] "We have not quantified it" has no question in the excerpt.
|   `-- [I] Cannot securely assign "it" solely to the PayPal effect.
|
`-- Key shared by every diagram
    [R] Filing / direct calculation; seed-only labels preserve provenance
    [S] Management or narrative statement, not independently verified
    [I] Interpretation, assumption or evidence limitation
    [X] Claim contradicted by supplied corpus
    D = dependency / feeds; M = structural connection; C = sequence
    mech = arithmetic; assoc = co-movement; data = management figure
    claim = assertion; untestable = missing evidence; contra = contradiction
    No causal-grade links; layout connectors use M:claim for decomposition.
